Name: Lumisteria's Farmer Backgrounds
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
[center][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img][/center]

Choose between 5 options : Dynamic (will change depending of location), Forest, Desert, Town, or Beach. Each option has day and night version. Includes an animated beach version if you use CPA, made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url].

Default option is Dynamic, and is the suggested option. When there is no corresponding background, or if the type of location doesn't have an associated background, background used will be the default one.

Note : this mod should be compatible with UI mods, but depending of how they patch the background, this mod may need to load after them. Let me know if you use an UI mod and this one isn't working with it.
